title: Typography, Text-on-Path & Glyph Styling
subtitle: Artistic Text vs Frame Text, Path Text, OpenType Features, Glyph Browser & Text Styles
description: Master professional typographic design: the fundamental distinction between Artistic Text and Frame Text, precision micro-kerning with keyboard modifiers, circular Text-on-Path badge layout, advanced OpenType stylistic alternates, and reusable Text Style hierarchies.
prerequisites: D02: Vector Nodes, Paths & Pen Tool Geometry
D04: Fill, Gradient, Stroke & Pressure Profiles
learningOutcomes: Choose appropriately between Artistic Text (display logos) and Frame Text (editorial body reflow).
Perform optical and metric micro-kerning and tracking using Alt/Option arrow key shortcuts.
Attach, position, and flip typography along open and closed vector curves using Text-on-Path handles.
Inspect, unlock, and assign OpenType glyph variants (ligatures, swashes, stylistic sets) via Typography & Glyph Studios.
Build a unified Text Style hierarchy (H1, H2, Body, Caption) for brand and product typography systems.

capstoneProject.title: Vintage Hand-Lettered Distillery Seal
capstoneProject.description: Construct an authentic vintage circular emblem featuring curved text along concentric outer and inner arcs, OpenType swash flourishes, and customized kerning pairs.
evaluationCriteria: Top and bottom circular text arcs aligned symmetrically using Text-on-Path.
OpenType ligatures or swashes utilized on headline typography.
Manual optical kerning applied to eliminate awkward character gaps.
